title: World map: oceans and continents
subject: Geography
source: Written for geography/y4 lesson 12 (World map: oceans and continents (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 12: The five oceans of the world. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

blocks.text: Label the seven continents: Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Australia (Oceania), Europe, North America, South America.

bullets: Most of Earth's water is salty

parts.text: Write: south of Asia, between Africa and Australia

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: The Indian Ocean is south of Asia, between Africa and Australia.

keywords.def: one of five huge areas of salt water
one of seven very large areas of land
the smallest ocean, around the North Pole

questions.q: Which ocean lies between Europe and North America?
Name two continents the Pacific touches.
questions.a: For example: Asia and North America

questions.q: Core: Label the five oceans and seven continents on the world map, then number the oceans 1 to 5 by size.
questions.a: All labels correct; Pacific 1, Atlantic 2, Indian 3, Southern 4, Arctic 5

questions.q: Extend: Write location sentences for two oceans.
questions.a: For example: The Arctic Ocean is north of Europe, Asia and North America.

questions.q: Stretch: Why might the oceans be important even to people who live far from the sea?
questions.a: They make rain clouds, give food and carry ships with goods
B) Arctic. The Arctic Ocean around the North Pole is the smallest; the Pacific is the largest.

questions.q: Big question: Planet Earth or Planet Ocean?
questions.a: A reasoned answer, e.g. Planet Ocean, because about 71% is ocean
